title: Safe parrots
description: Clever parrots will not eat your cookies！
body:
## Still worry about your parrots that they will be poisoned by cookies? 
Our Safe parrots is a extremely lightweight mod. It will make your parrots cleverer. They will be able to tell if you feed them with a cookie! If so, they will refuse to eat it! 

This mod works with [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api).
